comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
If you undertake the Land Surveying quest (available from Oxford's Professor after beginning Mercator's World Atlas quest by charting the North Sea and then completing the Legend of the Labyrinthos quest), then at 40 land regions charted (including West Siberian Plain zone), you can receive a special mission to chart the Caucasus zone. Complete that particular task, report to Oxford's Professor, and you will receive this item.

Stats:

Appraisal/Art/Persuasion +1
15k fame to equip, unisex

Can be upgraded via Transmutation Alchemy into King's Feather Crown EX -- appropriately, with the Age effect (Mythical Era) EX Effect.

Oh, and this item is not to be confused with the visually similar color-custom Peacock Feather Crown item. Cheers.
